edges.reason: The from parameter is consumed by the _transfer override for balance and limit checks.
The to parameter drives maxWallet, AMM pair and fee logic in _transfer.
The amount parameter is used for limit checks and fee computation in _transfer.
block.timestamp gates the automatic LP burn and auto buyback branches in _transfer.
tx.origin is used to throttle transfers during launch, making logic dependent on the originating EOA.
tx.origin is written to and read from the _holderLastTransferBlock anti-bot mapping.
msg.sender from the constructor is stored as the dev wallet and receives ETH.
msg.sender is the destination of the low-level ETH call in withdrawStuckETH.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) sets the initial owner in the Ownable constructor.
_transfer invokes swapBack, which performs external calls while swapping is being toggled.
_transfer invokes autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens, which performs an external pair.sync().
_transfer invokes autoBuyBack, which performs an external router swap.
_transfer reads and writes the swapping guard around the swapBack call.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call which can re-enter the token.
addLiquidity performs an external router addLiquidityETH call with ETH value.
autoBuyBack performs an external router swapExactETHForTokens call.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on the LP pair.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastLpBurnTime.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens stores block.timestamp as lastLpBurnTime.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses percentForLPBurn to compute the burn amount.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on the LP pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses block.timestamp for cooldown checks.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
launch calls the factory createPair to create the LP pair.
launch performs an external addLiquidityETH call with the contract ETH balance.
launch sets dexRouter to the router address.
launch stores the newly created pair into lpPair.
launch sets tradingActive to true.
launch sets swapEnabled to true.
launch records tradingActiveBlock = block.number.
launch stores the provided _blockPenalty.
launch initializes lastLpBurnTime with block.timestamp.
forceSwapBack calls the external-calling swapBack routine.
forceSwapBack toggles the swapping guard around swapBack.
forceSwapBack is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
buyBackTokens performs an external router swapExactETHForTokens call.
buyBackTokens is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawStuckETH forwards all contract ETH via a low-level call to msg.sender.
withdrawStuckETH requires tradingActive to be false.
withdrawStuckETH is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
swapBack sends ETH to devWallet via a low-level call, allowing re-entry.
swapBack sends ETH to marketingWallet via a low-level call, allowing re-entry.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external router swap.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH are available.
swapBack resets tokensForMarketing to zero.
swapBack resets tokensForLiquidity to zero and uses it for share math.
swapBack resets tokensForBuyBack to zero.
swapBack resets tokensForDev to zero.
swapBack uses devWallet as the ETH recipient address.
swapBack uses marketingWallet as the ETH recipient address.
setAutoBuyBackSettings updates autoBuyBackFrequency.
setAutoBuyBackSettings updates amountForAutoBuyBack.
setAutoBuyBackSettings updates autoBuyBackEnabled.
setAutoBuyBackSettings is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setAutoLPBurnSettings updates lpBurnFrequency.
setAutoLPBurnSettings updates percentForLPBurn.
setAutoLPBurnSettings updates lpBurnEnabled.
setAutoLPBurnSettings is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTxnAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
updateMaxWalletAmount is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees from the individual buy fee components.
updateBuyFees is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees from the individual sell fee components.
updateSellFees is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
excludeFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
excludeFromFees is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the _isExcludedmaxTxnAmount mapping.
excludeFromMaxTransaction is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateMarketingWallet writes the marketingWallet address.
updateMarketingWallet is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateDevWallet writes the devWallet address.
updateDevWallet is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
isPenaltyActive compares tradingActiveBlock against block.number minus blockPenalty.
isPenaltyActive reads tradingActiveBlock to determine the penalty window.
renounceOwnership clears the owner address.
transferOwnership sets a new owner address.
isExcludedFromFees reads the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
The constructor sets the marketingWallet address.
The constructor sets devWallet to msg.sender.
The constructor computes buyTotalFees from the buy fee components.
The constructor computes sellTotalFees from the sell fee components.
The constructor derives maxTxnAmount from total supply.
The constructor derives maxWallet from total supply.
The constructor derives swapTokensAtAmount from total supply.
contractTokenBalance local is computed in _transfer to decide the swap trigger.
canSwap local gates the swapBack invocation in _transfer.
takeFee local determines whether transfer fees are applied.
fees local is computed via multiplications/divisions on amount and can underflow amount -= fees.
contractBalance local is read and capped inside swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap local is the divisor in swapBack share arithmetic.
amountToBurn local is computed from LP balance and percentForLPBurn.
liquidityTokens local participates in division-based share computation in swapBack.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists as input to the _transfer override and has no independent semantics.
The to parameter only exists as input to the _transfer override and has no independent semantics.
The amount parameter only exists as input to the _transfer override and has no independent semantics.
The amountInWei parameter is directly consumed by autoBuyBack and buyBackTokens router swaps.
The frequency parameter is validated and stored by the auto buyback/LP burn configuration functions.
The percent parameter directly determines the manual LP burn amount.
The newNum parameter is the direct input of the limit update functions.
The _blockPenalty parameter is consumed by launch when activating trading.
The account parameter is the direct key written by the fee exclusion functions.
The isEx boolean is the direct value written by the exclusion/AMM-pair functions.
The new wallet parameter is stored by the wallet update functions.
The contract token balance local is only meaningful within the _transfer swap trigger logic.
The canSwap local is a derived boolean used only by _transfer.
The takeFee local is a derived boolean used only by _transfer.
The fees local is a transient computation used only inside the _transfer fee logic.
The contractBalance local is a transient value scoped to swapBack.
The totalTokensToSwap local is a transient denominator scoped to swapBack.
The amountToBurn local is a transient value scoped to the burn functions.
The liquidityTokens local is a transient intermediate scoped to swapBack.
